title: Polis: 3D Self-Supervision at City Scale
abstract: arXiv:2608.29426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable semantic representations derived from city-scale 3D models are increasingly important for urban analysis, infrastructure monitoring, autonomous systems, and heritage conservation. However, urban scenes of large spatial extent captured through aerial surveying differ substantially from the indoor, object-level, and self-driving LiDAR data used to pretrain most 3D self-supervised models. We introduce Polis, to our knowledge the first application of Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) as an objective for a native point cloud encoder, and evaluate it through a frozen-feature benchmark spanning fourteen city- and building-scale corpora. Polis combines geometrically matched cosine invariance, SIGReg, and VICReg-style anti-collapse terms with a 12.8k-scene outdoor pretraining mixture and gravity-preserving spatial view sampling. Controlled ablations show that this objective outperforms student--teacher architecture al

translated_title: Polis：城市尺度的3D自监督学习
translated_abstract: 从城市尺度3D模型中提取的可靠语义表示，对于城市分析、基础设施监测、自主系统和遗产保护而言正变得越来越重要。然而，通过航空测量获取的大空间范围城市场景，与用于预训练大多数3D自监督模型的室内、物体级以及自动驾驶LiDAR数据存在本质差异。我们提出了Polis，据我们所知，这是首次将草图化各向同性高斯正则化（SIGReg）作为原生点云编码器的训练目标，并通过覆盖十四个城市与建筑规模语料库的冻结特征基准对其进行评估。Polis将几何匹配的余弦不变性、SIGReg以及VICReg风格的防坍缩项相结合，并配合包含12.8k场景的户外预训练混合数据集与保持重力方向的空间视图采样。受控消融实验表明，该目标函数优于师生架构方法。
tldr: Polis是首个将SIGReg目标应用于原生点云编码器的城市尺度3D自监督学习方法，通过几何匹配的余弦不变性、防坍缩项和保持重力方向的视图采样，在十四个城市与建筑规模基准上表现出色。
en_tdlr: Polis is the first application of SIGReg as an objective for a native point cloud encoder, enabling city-scale 3D self-supervised learning through geometrically matched cosine invariance, anti-collapse terms, and gravity-preserving view sampling, achieving strong performance across fourteen city- and building-scale benchmarks.
